issues.title: Dangling External Module References
issues.why: The spec references external modules (e.g., 02-coding-guidelines, 03-error-manage, 04-database-conventions, 27-spec-toolchain) that are not provided in the context, making it impossible for an AI to verify cross-link integrity or inherited rules.
issues.fix: Provide the 00-overview.md and 97-acceptance-criteria.md for all referenced modules in the context.

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Conditions in Linter Scripts
issues.why: The spec mandates multiple linter scripts (Python, Node, Go) running in a pipeline but does not define behavior for concurrent execution or file-locking during the 'self-heal' (--fix) phase.
issues.fix: Add a section to 10-mandatory-linter-infrastructure.md specifying a lockfile mechanism or sequential execution requirement for --fix operations.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Phase' Numbering
issues.why: The spec frequently references 'Phases' (e.g., Phase 48, Phase 153) as normative anchors, but the definition of a 'Phase' and its sequence is not pinned in the provided files.
issues.fix: Define the 'Phase' schema and its canonical source (e.g., a phase-registry.json) in 01-folder-structure.md.
